test_find_binning_thresholds: test the _find_binning_thresholds function computes correct bin thresholds for regular and random data
test_bin_mapper_transform: test the _BinMapper class fits on data and transforms features into binned uint8 values
test_map_to_bins: test the _map_to_bins function maps continuous data to binned indices using threshold arrays
test_categorical_feature: test the _BinMapper class handles categorical features with known categories and maps them correctly
test_missing_values_support: test the _BinMapper class maps NaN values to the last bin and handles missing value attributes
